auth.title: Sign in to GNERAI OS
auth.subtitle: For GNERAI partners only.
auth.sentBody: If {email} has an account, we've sent it a sign-in link. It expires in an hour.
auth.errorLink: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.useLink: Sign in with an email link
auth.linkIntro: We'll email you a sign-in link. Then we'll ask for the code on your phone.
auth.resetIntro: We'll email you a link to create a new password.
auth.resetSentBody: If {email} has an account, we've sent it a link to create a new password. It expires in an hour.
auth.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.

mfa.challengeSubtitle: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit GNERAI OS code.
mfa.enrollSubtitle: Two-step verification is required: even if someone knew your password, they couldn't sign in without your phone.
mfa.enrollStep1: Install an authenticator app: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
mfa.enrollStep2: Scan this QR code with it (or type the key by hand).
mfa.enrollStep3: Type the 6-digit code it shows below.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.secretHint: If you can't scan it, type this key into the app:
mfa.lostDevice: Lost your phone? Ask another partner to reset your verification from Settings → Team.
mfa.errorCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Type the one showing in the app now.
mfa.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
mfa.errorLoad: Verification could not be set up. Try again.

subtitles.setup: You'll use it to sign in to GNERAI OS, together with the code on your phone.
subtitles.reset: Choose a new password. The old one stops working.
subtitles.change: Choose a new password for your account.

password.managerHint: Tip: keep it in a password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, Apple or Google Passwords).
password.errorWeak: The password doesn't meet the rules.
password.errorSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
password.errorLeaked: That password is too weak or has appeared in leaks: choose another.
password.errorSame: It's the same as your current one: choose another.
password.errorReauth: For security, sign in again before changing it.
password.errorGeneric: It couldn't be saved. Try again.

code.label: Your access code
code.hint: 8 digits, personal. The first time on a new device we'll ask you to confirm it by email.
code.errorGeneric: Couldn't sign you in. Try again in a moment.
code.deviceSentBody: It's your first time on this device. We've emailed {email}: open it and tap “Yes, it's me”. If you open it here, you'll be signed in straight away; if you open it somewhere else, come back and type your code again.
code.hintDirect: 8 digits, personal. Don't share it with anyone.
code.entering: Signing you in to GNERAI OS…

device.title: Is it you, {name}?
device.body: Your code was typed on a new device: {device}. If it's you, confirm it and from now on you'll sign in there with just your code.
device.confirm: Yes, it's me: confirm this device
device.notMe: Wasn't you? Close this page and change your code in Settings → Preferences: someone knows it.
device.doneBody: Go back to the tab where you typed your code and type it again to sign in.
device.invalidBody: Type your code on the new device again and we'll send you another link.
